p1: [whispers] At 2 a.m., Liam's flatmate Josh texted him:
[low, ominous] Don't turn on the lights when you get home.
[low, quiet] Weird. Josh never texts. His phone stays on the couch.
[whispers, uneasy] Liam left the lights off. From the lounge room... he heard breathing.
[low, nervous] In bed, he texted: was that you? It replied instantly.
[whispers, slow, menacing] Go to sleep... [pause] I'll be right here.
[whispers, tense] Under the covers, Liam waited. Then he looked out. [pause] Nothing.
[low, unsettled] Then the heat hit. Burning, like a fever.
[whispers, frightened] Whispers started. Not in the room. [pause] Inside his head.
[shaky, urgent] He couldn't breathe. He gasped for air.
[panicked, shouting] Liam! What's wrong? What's wrong?!
[voice breaking] Liam grabbed his arm. His last words...
[whispers, terrified] Then a voice came out of Liam's mouth.
[whispers, slow, menacing] I told you... [pause] I'd be right here.
[low, somber] Liam and Josh were never seen again. [pause] Nobody knows what happened to them.
[whispers] People never last long in that flat. They move out... [pause] or they disappear.
